# pvecli cluster create

Turn the node of this profile into the first member of a new cluster.

```text
pvecli cluster create [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | Cluster name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--link0 VALUE` | Address of this node on corosync link 0. |
| `--link1 VALUE` | Address on corosync link 1. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip the typed confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile of the standalone node. |
